24840bfa-7ac2-46f9-b731-15d0c2fa045f.title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
24840bfa-7ac2-46f9-b731-15d0c2fa045f.eligibility_description: Urban families without a pucca house in India. Annual household income must be below Rs 3,00,000 for EWS and Rs 6,00,000 for LIG.
24840bfa-7ac2-46f9-b731-15d0c2fa045f.benefits_summary: Upfront interest subsidy up to Rs 2.67 Lakhs on home loans for building or purchasing a house.

acb0d3f8-6359-4dc3-90dd-647ad425a885.title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
acb0d3f8-6359-4dc3-90dd-647ad425a885.eligibility_description: Rural homeless families and households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses selected via SECC 2011 data.
acb0d3f8-6359-4dc3-90dd-647ad425a885.benefits_summary: Rs 1,20,000 direct cash assistance transferred in installments into bank accounts, plus 90 days MGNREGA unskilled labor wage support.

18a6ca99-eef7-4ddd-a451-91246833cf0f.title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi Scheme
18a6ca99-eef7-4ddd-a451-91246833cf0f.title_ta: பி.எம். கிசான் விவசாயிகள் நிதி உதவி திட்டம்
18a6ca99-eef7-4ddd-a451-91246833cf0f.eligibility_description: All landholding farmers with cultivable land in their names, subject to exclusion criteria for high income / institutional landholders.
18a6ca99-eef7-4ddd-a451-91246833cf0f.benefits_summary: Rs 6,000 per year paid in three installments of Rs 2,000 directly into bank accounts through DBT.

c0a40e9c-bd34-4e91-8696-c669b09bf8e4.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
c0a40e9c-bd34-4e91-8696-c669b09bf8e4.eligibility_description: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
c0a40e9c-bd34-4e91-8696-c669b09bf8e4.benefits_summary: Full financial claim settlement for crop loss with maximum premium of 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial crops.

37571c6a-6441-4d8c-ab5c-c09aa17ed52d.title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
37571c6a-6441-4d8c-ab5c-c09aa17ed52d.eligibility_description: Individual/joint farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and Self Help Groups (SHGs) involved in agriculture and allied activities.
37571c6a-6441-4d8c-ab5c-c09aa17ed52d.benefits_summary: Revolving credit limit up to Rs 3 Lakhs at concessional 4% interest rate (with prompt repayment subvention).

90f571fc-7318-4ddf-b795-1d648f87d708.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Health Insurance
90f571fc-7318-4ddf-b795-1d648f87d708.title_ta: ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத் பிரதம மந்திரி ஜன் ஆரோக்கிய யோஜனா
90f571fc-7318-4ddf-b795-1d648f87d708.eligibility_description: Bottom 40% vulnerable and poor families identified based on SECC 2011 deprivation criteria.
90f571fc-7318-4ddf-b795-1d648f87d708.benefits_summary: Cashless and paperless hospitalization treatment up to Rs 5,00,000 per family annually in empaneled public and private hospitals.

936ad6fe-082e-456d-bb16-721fef5166ba.title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
936ad6fe-082e-456d-bb16-721fef5166ba.title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி ஜீவன் ஜோதி பீமா யோஜனா (ஆயுள் காப்பீடு)
936ad6fe-082e-456d-bb16-721fef5166ba.eligibility_description: Individuals aged 18 to 50 years holding a bank/post office savings account with auto-debit consent.
936ad6fe-082e-456d-bb16-721fef5166ba.benefits_summary: Rs 2,00,000 life risk coverage payable to nominee upon death of subscriber for an annual premium of Rs 436.

f72bf699-9d7b-4f94-807f-324794ab2c68.title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
f72bf699-9d7b-4f94-807f-324794ab2c68.title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி சுரக்ஷா பீமா யோஜனா (விபத்து காப்பீடு)
f72bf699-9d7b-4f94-807f-324794ab2c68.eligibility_description: Individuals aged 18 to 70 years holding a bank account with auto-debit facility.
f72bf699-9d7b-4f94-807f-324794ab2c68.benefits_summary: Rs 2,00,000 for accidental death / total disability and Rs 1,00,000 for partial disability at an annual premium of Rs 20.

be98da39-4c2a-4bf5-a0af-db3a344d4acf.title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
be98da39-4c2a-4bf5-a0af-db3a344d4acf.title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி மாத்ரு வந்தனா யோஜனா (கர்ப்பிணி உதவி)
be98da39-4c2a-4bf5-a0af-db3a344d4acf.eligibility_description: Pregnant women and lactating mothers aged 19+ for first child, and for second girl child. Excludes regular government employees.
be98da39-4c2a-4bf5-a0af-db3a344d4acf.benefits_summary: Rs 5,000 in two installments for 1st child, and Rs 6,000 in single installment on birth of 2nd girl child.

eae6e570-e275-464b-93c5-61837e0e9c22.title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
eae6e570-e275-464b-93c5-61837e0e9c22.eligibility_description: Girl child below 10 years of age. A maximum of two accounts per family (three in case of twin girls).
eae6e570-e275-464b-93c5-61837e0e9c22.benefits_summary: Highest tax-free compounding interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a.) under Section 80C, with maturity at 21 years.

705ba63a-4e00-4ac3-b486-5f7a379ac969.title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
705ba63a-4e00-4ac3-b486-5f7a379ac969.title_ta: இந்திரா காந்தி தேசிய முதியோர் ஓய்வூதியத் திட்டம்
705ba63a-4e00-4ac3-b486-5f7a379ac969.eligibility_description: Senior citizens aged 60 years or above belonging to a recognized BPL household.
705ba63a-4e00-4ac3-b486-5f7a379ac969.benefits_summary: Monthly cash pension of Rs 200 to Rs 500 (supplemented further by state government top-ups up to Rs 1,000-2,000).

df00d37b-4f85-490e-9840-195493904c78.title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
df00d37b-4f85-490e-9840-195493904c78.title_ta: இந்திரா காந்தி தேசிய விதவை ஓய்வூதியத் திட்டம்
df00d37b-4f85-490e-9840-195493904c78.eligibility_description: Widows aged between 40 and 79 years belonging to a household living below the poverty line.
df00d37b-4f85-490e-9840-195493904c78.benefits_summary: Monthly pension of Rs 300 central share, plus state matching grant transferred directly into bank accounts.

61950236-3c2a-494a-957a-d955f1b507f2.title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
61950236-3c2a-494a-957a-d955f1b507f2.title_ta: இந்திரா காந்தி தேசிய மாற்றுத்திறனாளிகள் ஓய்வூதியத் திட்டம்
61950236-3c2a-494a-957a-d955f1b507f2.eligibility_description: Persons aged 18 to 79 years with 80% or higher severe disability belonging to BPL households.
61950236-3c2a-494a-957a-d955f1b507f2.benefits_summary: Monthly cash pension support directly deposited into beneficiary bank accounts.

091d63be-cf86-4faa-90b4-5ab0de825197.title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
091d63be-cf86-4faa-90b4-5ab0de825197.eligibility_description: Street vendors vending in urban areas on or before March 24, 2020 holding Certificate of Vending / Vending ID.
091d63be-cf86-4faa-90b4-5ab0de825197.benefits_summary: Collateral-free working capital loans of Rs 10,000 (1st tranche), Rs 20,000 (2nd tranche), and Rs 50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy.

5e774665-1159-4318-807d-4412ae308b76.title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
5e774665-1159-4318-807d-4412ae308b76.eligibility_description: Artisans working in 18 traditional trades (e.g., carpenter, blacksmith, cobbler, tailor, weaver, potter, mason) aged 18+.
5e774665-1159-4318-807d-4412ae308b76.benefits_summary: Vishwakarma ID card, 5-7 days basic skill training with Rs 500/day stipend, Rs 15,000 toolkit e-voucher, and up to Rs 3 Lakh collateral-free loan at 5% interest.

bb61b4dd-cbf6-422a-8af1-398516daec63.title: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
bb61b4dd-cbf6-422a-8af1-398516daec63.eligibility_description: Any individual above 18 years of age. Minimum 8th class pass for project cost exceeding Rs 10 Lakhs in manufacturing.
bb61b4dd-cbf6-422a-8af1-398516daec63.benefits_summary: Capital margin money subsidy of 15% to 35% on project cost up to Rs 50 Lakhs for manufacturing and Rs 20 Lakhs for service sector.

8fd769fe-756e-42c0-8561-fd041d7ec9f9.title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
8fd769fe-756e-42c0-8561-fd041d7ec9f9.eligibility_description: Indian youth aged 15 to 45 years who are unemployed or school/college dropouts.
8fd769fe-756e-42c0-8561-fd041d7ec9f9.benefits_summary: Free industry skill training, government certification, assessment stipend, and placement assistance.

0fe15534-363d-4e0c-96f0-bbccbd6b7785.title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
0fe15534-363d-4e0c-96f0-bbccbd6b7785.title_ta: மகாத்மா காந்தி தேசிய ஊரக வேலை உறுதியளிப்புத் திட்டம் (100 நாள் வேலை)
0fe15534-363d-4e0c-96f0-bbccbd6b7785.eligibility_description: Adult members of rural households holding a valid Job Card willing to do manual labor.
0fe15534-363d-4e0c-96f0-bbccbd6b7785.benefits_summary: Guaranteed minimum wage payment (notified state-wise) transferred directly into bank/post office accounts within 15 days.

0bd8cbf1-bd03-478d-bedd-71774582bc2b.title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
0bd8cbf1-bd03-478d-bedd-71774582bc2b.title_ta: தேசிய வழிமுறைகள் மற்றும் தகுதி உதவித்தொகை திட்டம்
0bd8cbf1-bd03-478d-bedd-71774582bc2b.eligibility_description: Students studying in Class IX to XII in Govt/Aided schools having minimum 55% marks in Class VIII and parental income under Rs 3.5 Lakhs.
0bd8cbf1-bd03-478d-bedd-71774582bc2b.benefits_summary: Rs 12,000 per annum (Rs 1,000 per month) deposited directly via DBT into student bank account.

5e0a6610-e32d-4c7c-a777-2d659181f2ac.title: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students (NSP-PMS-SC)
5e0a6610-e32d-4c7c-a777-2d659181f2ac.eligibility_description: Scheduled Caste (SC) students enrolled in recognized post-matric courses with parental income under Rs 2.50 Lakhs per annum.
5e0a6610-e32d-4c7c-a777-2d659181f2ac.benefits_summary: Full non-refundable fee reimbursement plus monthly maintenance allowance directly credited through DBT.

636893bd-258a-43e5-b956-63b8e661d359.title: PM KUSUM Solar Pump Scheme
636893bd-258a-43e5-b956-63b8e661d359.title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி குசும் சூரிய மின்சக்தி பம்ப் திட்டம்
636893bd-258a-43e5-b956-63b8e661d359.eligibility_description: Farmers, panchayats, cooperatives, and Water User Associations (WUAs) owning agricultural land.
636893bd-258a-43e5-b956-63b8e661d359.benefits_summary: up to 60% total subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) for setting up standalone solar pumps up to 10 HP capacity.

8301eb7d-54e1-4c79-b902-cd3d21e61152.title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
8301eb7d-54e1-4c79-b902-cd3d21e61152.eligibility_description: Any Indian citizen with a non-farm business plan for manufacturing, trading, or service activity requiring credit up to Rs 10 Lakhs.
8301eb7d-54e1-4c79-b902-cd3d21e61152.benefits_summary: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishor (Rs 50k to 5L), and Tarun (Rs 5L to 10L) collateral-free bank credit.

b2aa19c7-a8fb-4d9b-a6b3-7b5426986f9f.title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
b2aa19c7-a8fb-4d9b-a6b3-7b5426986f9f.eligibility_description: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years holding a bank account and not covered by any statutory social security / income tax payer.
b2aa19c7-a8fb-4d9b-a6b3-7b5426986f9f.benefits_summary: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000, or 5,000 starting at age 60 based on contribution.

7aa78268-00dc-42b7-aa0e-933968ddd09a.title: PM Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (Free LPG Connection)
7aa78268-00dc-42b7-aa0e-933968ddd09a.title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி உஜ்வாலா திட்டம் (இலவச சமையல் எரிவாயு இணைப்பு)
7aa78268-00dc-42b7-aa0e-933968ddd09a.eligibility_description: Adult woman belonging to BPL / SC / ST / PMAY / Antyodaya Anna Yojana household without existing LPG connection.
7aa78268-00dc-42b7-aa0e-933968ddd09a.benefits_summary: Free LPG connection, security deposit waiver, free 14.2 kg cylinder refill, and stove.

d884aaab-fbf3-468d-8571-5b4882611c87.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
d884aaab-fbf3-468d-8571-5b4882611c87.eligibility_description: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, fisheries cooperatives, and SHGs.
d884aaab-fbf3-468d-8571-5b4882611c87.benefits_summary: 40% financial assistance for General category and 60% for Women / SC / ST beneficiaries for fish farming equipment and boats.

81b7af8c-7464-4808-b0d4-0fc7ac7f657f.title: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
81b7af8c-7464-4808-b0d4-0fc7ac7f657f.title_ta: சமக்ரா சிக்ஷா ஒருங்கிணைந்த பள்ளிக் கல்வித் திட்டம்
81b7af8c-7464-4808-b0d4-0fc7ac7f657f.eligibility_description: All school-going children studying in Government and Government-aided schools across India.
81b7af8c-7464-4808-b0d4-0fc7ac7f657f.benefits_summary: Free textbooks, free uniforms, digital classrooms, and infrastructure development grants for schools.

d8ab9cae-8f51-47c1-92f1-4f86e261c09c.title: PM POSHAN Mid-Day Meal Scheme
d8ab9cae-8f51-47c1-92f1-4f86e261c09c.eligibility_description: Children studying in primary and upper primary classes in Government and Govt-aided schools.
d8ab9cae-8f51-47c1-92f1-4f86e261c09c.benefits_summary: Free hot cooked meal containing minimum 450 calories and 12g protein for primary and 700 calories for upper primary.

4f4ccc0d-c6b7-445e-b629-418916668b39.title: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
4f4ccc0d-c6b7-445e-b629-418916668b39.eligibility_description: Rural households in any village across India without an existing clean tap water connection.
4f4ccc0d-c6b7-445e-b629-418916668b39.benefits_summary: Piped drinking water supply of 55 liters per capita per day directly to household premises.

423649db-51de-4b62-8cbf-4af83664c21c.title: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
423649db-51de-4b62-8cbf-4af83664c21c.title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி பாரதிய மக்கள் மருந்தக திட்டம்
423649db-51de-4b62-8cbf-4af83664c21c.eligibility_description: All citizens of India purchasing generic medicines at PMBJP Kendra outlets.
423649db-51de-4b62-8cbf-4af83664c21c.benefits_summary: Access to 1,900+ generic medicines and 290+ surgical devices at nominal cost.

72d8bfe5-ba91-407e-b7b9-0b637f7201e9.title: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Scheme
72d8bfe5-ba91-407e-b7b9-0b637f7201e9.eligibility_description: Female head of household residing in Tamil Nadu aged 21+, annual family income below Rs 2.5 Lakhs, landholding under 5 acres wetland / 10 acres dryland, and annual electricity usage below 3,600 units.
72d8bfe5-ba91-407e-b7b9-0b637f7201e9.benefits_summary: Rs 1,000 per month directly credited into beneficiary bank account.

9c91931b-5394-4548-8c63-8c467f760d2a.title: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammiyar Higher Education)
9c91931b-5394-4548-8c63-8c467f760d2a.title_ta: மூவலூர் ராமாமிர்தம் அம்மையார் புதுமைப் பெண் திட்டம்
9c91931b-5394-4548-8c63-8c467f760d2a.eligibility_description: Girl students who studied Classes 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu Government schools currently enrolled in undergraduate, diploma, ITI, or professional degree programs.
9c91931b-5394-4548-8c63-8c467f760d2a.benefits_summary: Rs 1,000 per month deposited directly into student bank account until course completion.

e1266d38-5883-4fd2-9531-eea9b1b94bc2.title: Tamil Pudhalvan Scheme
e1266d38-5883-4fd2-9531-eea9b1b94bc2.eligibility_description: Male students who studied Classes 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu Government schools pursuing higher education degree, diploma, or ITI courses.
e1266d38-5883-4fd2-9531-eea9b1b94bc2.benefits_summary: Rs 1,000 per month credited directly into student bank accounts.

b22feeca-314a-4b4f-b0fc-89c6c7c73822.title: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
b22feeca-314a-4b4f-b0fc-89c6c7c73822.eligibility_description: Resident families in Tamil Nadu with annual household income below Rs 1,20,000 listed in Smart Ration Card.
b22feeca-314a-4b4f-b0fc-89c6c7c73822.benefits_summary: Cashless hospital treatment up to Rs 5,00,000 annually for 1,500+ specialized medical procedures.

dbe3aaa7-a7dd-4ff0-be67-5e2a457cd0f2.title: Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme
dbe3aaa7-a7dd-4ff0-be67-5e2a457cd0f2.eligibility_description: All primary school students studying from Class 1 to 5 in Tamil Nadu Government schools.
dbe3aaa7-a7dd-4ff0-be67-5e2a457cd0f2.benefits_summary: Free nutritious breakfast served daily (Upma, Rava Pongal, Khichdi with Sambar) to prevent malnutrition and improve school attendance.

aa199fa4-b342-49bc-b212-2d1301c65c5f.title: Naan Mudhalvan Skill Development Scheme
aa199fa4-b342-49bc-b212-2d1301c65c5f.eligibility_description: Students studying in engineering, arts, science, polytechnic, and vocational colleges in Tamil Nadu.
aa199fa4-b342-49bc-b212-2d1301c65c5f.benefits_summary: Free high-tech training courses (AI, Data Science, Cloud, Coding), industrial internships, and campus placement drives.

69cb5f21-e81a-4754-bb6e-546478e7d715.title: Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam (Healthcare at Doorsteps)
69cb5f21-e81a-4754-bb6e-546478e7d715.eligibility_description: All residents of Tamil Nadu, specifically senior citizens, bedridden patients, and patients with hypertension/diabetes.
69cb5f21-e81a-4754-bb6e-546478e7d715.benefits_summary: Free doorstep delivery of monthly NCD medicines, home dialysis supplies, physiotherapy, and palliative care.

db16aa4d-789b-450e-a814-fa7bf6c1a6ca.title: Innuyir Kappon - Nammai Kakkum 48 Emergency Care
db16aa4d-789b-450e-a814-fa7bf6c1a6ca.eligibility_description: Any victim involved in a road traffic accident within the geographical boundaries of Tamil Nadu, regardless of state/nationality.
db16aa4d-789b-450e-a814-fa7bf6c1a6ca.benefits_summary: Free emergency medical treatment up to Rs 1,00,000 per person in 600+ empaneled government and private hospitals for first 48 hours.

bb815d75-217e-4256-ab4c-10a3099fdb29.title: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme
bb815d75-217e-4256-ab4c-10a3099fdb29.title_ta: டாக்டர் முத்துலட்சுமி ரெட்டி மகப்பேறு நிதி உதவித் திட்டம்
bb815d75-217e-4256-ab4c-10a3099fdb29.eligibility_description: Pregnant women aged 19+ for first two deliveries belonging to poor households in Tamil Nadu registered in PICME portal.
bb815d75-217e-4256-ab4c-10a3099fdb29.benefits_summary: Rs 18,000 total financial assistance paid in 5 cash installments plus 2 Amma Nutrition Kits worth Rs 4,000.

4f0b05c2-464b-48cc-b4fa-526776c0f3bf.title: Chief Minister's Solar Powered Green House Scheme (CMSPGHS)
4f0b05c2-464b-48cc-b4fa-526776c0f3bf.title_ta: சூரிய சக்தியுடன் கூடிய பசுமை வீடுகள் திட்டம்
4f0b05c2-464b-48cc-b4fa-526776c0f3bf.eligibility_description: Rural BPL households in Tamil Nadu owning at least 300 sq ft land patta without any existing concrete house.
4f0b05c2-464b-48cc-b4fa-526776c0f3bf.benefits_summary: Rs 2,10,000 unit cost for house construction plus solar home lighting system fully funded by Govt.

3fdd56f1-1970-4052-b75d-e036a0696e74.title: Chief Minister's Farmers Security Scheme (Uzhavar Padhukappu Thittam)
3fdd56f1-1970-4052-b75d-e036a0696e74.eligibility_description: Small/marginal farmers owning up to 2.5 acres wetland or 5.0 acres dryland registered with Uzhavar Padhukappu card.
3fdd56f1-1970-4052-b75d-e036a0696e74.benefits_summary: Rs 1,000 monthly pension, Rs 10,000 marriage grant, Rs 20,000 natural death relief, and student educational scholarships.

92710cc5-65e6-406b-9acf-1d77cb5a3c4e.title: TN Differently Abled Maintenance Allowance Scheme
92710cc5-65e6-406b-9acf-1d77cb5a3c4e.eligibility_description: Persons with 40%+ to 75%+ benchmark disability residing in Tamil Nadu certified by District Medical Board.
92710cc5-65e6-406b-9acf-1d77cb5a3c4e.benefits_summary: Rs 2,000 per month deposited directly into beneficiary bank account.

78fdef92-a594-4640-b4f2-76427777684c.title: TN Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP)
78fdef92-a594-4640-b4f2-76427777684c.eligibility_description: Resident of Tamil Nadu for 3+ years, aged 18-35 (up to 45 for special categories), 8th class pass, with annual family income under Rs 5 Lakhs.
78fdef92-a594-4640-b4f2-76427777684c.benefits_summary: 25% capital subsidy on project cost up to Rs 15 Lakhs for manufacturing and Rs 5 Lakhs for service/business activities.

7797d9b3-de9f-4ab9-a1a3-aed3674123fa.title: TN New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS)
7797d9b3-de9f-4ab9-a1a3-aed3674123fa.title_ta: புதிய தொழில் முனைவோர் மற்றும் தொழில் நிறுவன மேம்பாட்டு திட்டம்
7797d9b3-de9f-4ab9-a1a3-aed3674123fa.eligibility_description: First-generation entrepreneurs aged 21-35 (up to 45 for SC/ST/Women/BC/BCM) holding a Degree, Diploma, or ITI qualification.
7797d9b3-de9f-4ab9-a1a3-aed3674123fa.benefits_summary: 25% capital subsidy (max Rs 75 Lakhs) on project cost between Rs 10 Lakhs and Rs 5 Crores, plus 3% interest subvention.

02c00523-6f11-4fdc-bba8-be76e6713c63.title: TN Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme (AABCS)
02c00523-6f11-4fdc-bba8-be76e6713c63.eligibility_description: Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) entrepreneurs setting up new businesses or expanding existing MSME units in TN.
02c00523-6f11-4fdc-bba8-be76e6713c63.benefits_summary: 35% capital subsidy (up to Rs 1.50 Crores) and 6% interest subvention for commercial bank loan.

44942dde-f814-4520-9289-b01a1047adb3.title: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammiyar Marriage Assistance Scheme
44942dde-f814-4520-9289-b01a1047adb3.title_ta: மூவலூர் ராமாமிர்தம் அம்மையார் திருமண நிதி உதவி திட்டம்
44942dde-f814-4520-9289-b01a1047adb3.eligibility_description: Poor girls residing in Tamil Nadu aged 18+ with annual family income below Rs 72,000 having studied 10th pass / 5th pass for ST.
44942dde-f814-4520-9289-b01a1047adb3.benefits_summary: Rs 25,000 cash grant (for 10th pass) or Rs 50,000 (for degree/diploma) plus 8 grams (1 sovereign) 22-carat gold coin for Thirumangalyam.

dc4d89b1-4617-43cc-b23c-834222f0357b.title: Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Widow Remarriage Scheme
dc4d89b1-4617-43cc-b23c-834222f0357b.title_ta: டாக்டர் தர்மாம்பாள் அம்மையார் விதவை மறுமண நிதி உதவித் திட்டம்
dc4d89b1-4617-43cc-b23c-834222f0357b.eligibility_description: Widows aged 20 to 30 years remarrying. No income ceiling or educational restrictions.
dc4d89b1-4617-43cc-b23c-834222f0357b.benefits_summary: Rs 25,000 cash grant (Rs 15,000 ECS + Rs 10,000 NSC bond) plus 8 grams 22K gold coin.

6613023f-034f-4ef8-a6e3-00500d0b0a7e.title: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
6613023f-034f-4ef8-a6e3-00500d0b0a7e.eligibility_description: Married women (including widows/divorced) resident of MP aged 21 to 60 years with family income below Rs 2.5 Lakhs.
6613023f-034f-4ef8-a6e3-00500d0b0a7e.benefits_summary: Rs 1,250 per month directly deposited into beneficiary Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.

5d45aead-5be4-44dd-857d-ab1f51b60556.title: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka)
5d45aead-5be4-44dd-857d-ab1f51b60556.eligibility_description: Women identified as head of household in BPL / APL / Antyodaya cards. Excludes tax-paying families.
5d45aead-5be4-44dd-857d-ab1f51b60556.benefits_summary: Rs 2,000 per month deposited directly into bank accounts via DBT.

b9027673-316d-4bc4-9add-3cfd175b8a81.title: Yuva Nidhi Unemployment Allowance Scheme (Karnataka)
b9027673-316d-4bc4-9add-3cfd175b8a81.eligibility_description: Graduates and diploma holders passing out in 2023 or later who remain unemployed after 180 days of graduation.
b9027673-316d-4bc4-9add-3cfd175b8a81.benefits_summary: Rs 3,000 per month for Degree graduates and Rs 1,500 per month for Diploma holders for up to 2 years.

cef985e4-1fbd-417b-8539-70b50ba8759c.title: Kanyashree Prakalpa (West Bengal)
cef985e4-1fbd-417b-8539-70b50ba8759c.eligibility_description: Unmarried girls aged 13-18 enrolled in Class VIII-XII (K1) and girls aged 18-19 pursuing higher study/vocational (K2).
cef985e4-1fbd-417b-8539-70b50ba8759c.benefits_summary: Annual scholarship of Rs 1,000 (K1) plus one-time grant of Rs 25,000 upon reaching 18 years of age (K2).

d753ae85-ed08-4642-a063-804780bd8457.title: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme (West Bengal)
d753ae85-ed08-4642-a063-804780bd8457.eligibility_description: Female resident of West Bengal aged 25 to 60 years. Excludes regular government employees.
d753ae85-ed08-4642-a063-804780bd8457.benefits_summary: Rs 1,000 per month for General category and Rs 1,200 per month for SC/ST women.

64cbb381-83f5-40af-be3b-398fe689002f.title: Subhadra Yojana (Odisha)
64cbb381-83f5-40af-be3b-398fe689002f.eligibility_description: Resident women of Odisha aged 21 to 60 years belonging to eligible non-income tax paying households.
64cbb381-83f5-40af-be3b-398fe689002f.benefits_summary: Rs 10,000 per year paid in two equal installments of Rs 5,000 on Rakhi Purnima and International Women's Day.

50b4f480-d12e-475c-8197-65b9b0fcdd15.title: KALIA Scheme for Farmers (Odisha)
50b4f480-d12e-475c-8197-65b9b0fcdd15.eligibility_description: Small and marginal farmers, sharecroppers, and landless agricultural households in Odisha.
50b4f480-d12e-475c-8197-65b9b0fcdd15.benefits_summary: Financial assistance of Rs 10,000 per year for cultivation plus Rs 12,500 for landless agricultural households.

07ef4553-8221-4156-9b57-88dbf0702f55.title: Mukhya Mantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
07ef4553-8221-4156-9b57-88dbf0702f55.eligibility_description: Resident of UP with annual family income below Rs 3 Lakhs. Maximum two girl children per family.
07ef4553-8221-4156-9b57-88dbf0702f55.benefits_summary: Rs 25,000 total monetary grant transferred in 6 stages (birth, immunization, class 1, class 6, class 9, degree entry).

e00078a2-f67b-4d01-b75b-d2121ef45d5e.title: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme (MNSSBY)
e00078a2-f67b-4d01-b75b-d2121ef45d5e.eligibility_description: Students who passed 12th standard from Bihar pursuing higher education degree or diploma courses.
e00078a2-f67b-4d01-b75b-d2121ef45d5e.benefits_summary: Collateral-free education loan up to Rs 4,00,000 at 1% interest rate for females / PwD and 4% for male students.

c04d566a-ce91-4eea-a493-ce091ed1d83e.title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY Gujarat)
c04d566a-ce91-4eea-a493-ce091ed1d83e.eligibility_description: Students securing 80%+ percentile in 10th/12th standard with annual family income under Rs 6.00 Lakhs.
c04d566a-ce91-4eea-a493-ce091ed1d83e.benefits_summary: 50% tuition fee subsidy (up to Rs 2 Lakhs/year for MBBS and Rs 50,000/year for Engineering) plus hostel and book allowance.

8ca0769d-4796-4585-b204-bce5ac78a224.title: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM-JANMAN)
8ca0769d-4796-4585-b204-bce5ac78a224.title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி பி.வி.டி.ஜி பழங்குடியினர் மேம்பாட்டு திட்டம்
8ca0769d-4796-4585-b204-bce5ac78a224.eligibility_description: Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTG) households across 18 States and Union Territories.
8ca0769d-4796-4585-b204-bce5ac78a224.benefits_summary: Pucca housing, clean drinking water, road connectivity, electricity, mobile medical units, and skill centers.

29c62b58-7ae4-46c6-911a-26259ae2f7e2.title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
29c62b58-7ae4-46c6-911a-26259ae2f7e2.eligibility_description: Youth aged 14+ having completed 5th/8th/10th/12th or ITI/Diploma/Degree enrolled in apprenticeship.
29c62b58-7ae4-46c6-911a-26259ae2f7e2.benefits_summary: Government reimburses 25% of prescribed stipend up to Rs 1,500 per month per apprentice directly to bank accounts via DBT.

480c5b48-efe8-41c3-a87d-03364da19180.title: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
480c5b48-efe8-41c3-a87d-03364da19180.title_ta: சிறு மற்றும் குறுந்தொழில் கடன் பிணை நிதித் திட்டம்
480c5b48-efe8-41c3-a87d-03364da19180.eligibility_description: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) involved in manufacturing or service activities seeking credit up to Rs 5 Crores.
480c5b48-efe8-41c3-a87d-03364da19180.benefits_summary: Credit guarantee coverage up to 85% for loans up to Rs 5 Lakhs (women/SC/ST/ZED units) and 75% for general loans without third-party collateral.

cc9755a8-cda8-4492-9a67-17a9908edffb.title: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme (PMNDP)
cc9755a8-cda8-4492-9a67-17a9908edffb.title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி தேசிய சிறுநீரக டயாலிசிஸ் திட்டம்
cc9755a8-cda8-4492-9a67-17a9908edffb.eligibility_description: End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) patients belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
cc9755a8-cda8-4492-9a67-17a9908edffb.benefits_summary: Free hemodialysis and home peritoneal dialysis support in all empaneled District Hospitals.

67d77cf8-91a1-43e2-b1f2-b5659ec76456.title: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
67d77cf8-91a1-43e2-b1f2-b5659ec76456.title_ta: தீன்தயாள் அந்தியோதயா யோஜனா - தேசிய ஊரக வாழ்வாதார இயக்கம்
67d77cf8-91a1-43e2-b1f2-b5659ec76456.eligibility_description: Rural poor households, specifically women organized into Self Help Groups (SHGs).
67d77cf8-91a1-43e2-b1f2-b5659ec76456.benefits_summary: Revolving Fund of Rs 20,000-30,000 per SHG, Community Investment Fund, and collateral-free bank loans up to Rs 20 Lakhs at 7% interest (subvention down to 4%).

52e44986-ae4a-46ba-8ca0-0681b0e20126.title: PM SVAMITVA Scheme (Property Cards for Rural Abadi)
52e44986-ae4a-46ba-8ca0-0681b0e20126.title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி சுவாமித்வா திட்டம் (கிராமப்புற மனை பட்டா அட்டை)
52e44986-ae4a-46ba-8ca0-0681b0e20126.eligibility_description: Rural property owners residing in inhabited (Abadi) areas of villages across India.
52e44986-ae4a-46ba-8ca0-0681b0e20126.benefits_summary: Official legal Property Card (Ghar Ka Patta) enabling property owners to use rural land as financial asset for taking bank loans.

a488f526-b5bf-4c3c-bc62-0e6ec2f540a7.title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
a488f526-b5bf-4c3c-bc62-0e6ec2f540a7.title_ta: ஏ.ஐ.சி.டி.இ பிரகதி மகளிர் தொழில்நுட்பக் கல்வி உதவித்தொகை
a488f526-b5bf-4c3c-bc62-0e6ec2f540a7.eligibility_description: Girl students admitted to AICTE approved Degree or Diploma courses with annual family income below Rs 8.00 Lakhs. Max 2 girls per family.
a488f526-b5bf-4c3c-bc62-0e6ec2f540a7.benefits_summary: Rs 50,000 per annum paid directly to student bank account for tuition fee and college expenses.

50b11745-8482-481c-8f87-4e1ac371c249.title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Differently Abled Students
50b11745-8482-481c-8f87-4e1ac371c249.title_ta: ஏ.ஐ.சி.டி.இ சக்ஷம் மாற்றுத்திறனாளி மாணவர் கல்வி உதவித்தொகை
50b11745-8482-481c-8f87-4e1ac371c249.eligibility_description: Differently-abled students with 40%+ benchmark disability admitted to AICTE approved technical Degree/Diploma with income below Rs 8 Lakhs.
50b11745-8482-481c-8f87-4e1ac371c249.benefits_summary: Rs 50,000 per annum for tuition fee, books, and assistive devices.

adac7101-e96b-4c0f-ba2e-fbbaf6161c28.title: Chief Minister's Girl Child Protection Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
adac7101-e96b-4c0f-ba2e-fbbaf6161c28.eligibility_description: Families in Tamil Nadu with one or two girl children and no male child, parent sterilized before 35 years, annual income under Rs 72,000.
adac7101-e96b-4c0f-ba2e-fbbaf6161c28.benefits_summary: Rs 50,000 fixed deposit for single girl child (or Rs 25,000 each for two girl children) maturing with interest when girl turns 18.

77406aa1-ace7-42d5-9aad-a2a0ec269b13.title: TN Transgender Welfare Board Assistance Scheme
77406aa1-ace7-42d5-9aad-a2a0ec269b13.eligibility_description: Transgender persons residing in Tamil Nadu registered with the Tamil Nadu Transgender Welfare Board.
77406aa1-ace7-42d5-9aad-a2a0ec269b13.benefits_summary: Free Transgender ID Card, Rs 1,000 monthly pension (above 40 yrs), Rs 20,000 self-employment grant, and free housing plots.

b24a8714-bc1f-4771-85ed-d74350579b34.title: TN Free Supply of Sewing Machines Scheme for Destitute Women
b24a8714-bc1f-4771-85ed-d74350579b34.title_ta: ஆதரவற்ற மகளிருக்கு இலவச தையல் எந்திரம் வழங்கும் திட்டம்
b24a8714-bc1f-4771-85ed-d74350579b34.eligibility_description: Destitute women, widows, deserted wives, or differently-abled women aged 20-40 residing in TN with family income under Rs 72,000 having tailoring training.
b24a8714-bc1f-4771-85ed-d74350579b34.benefits_summary: Free full-sized motorized sewing machine supplied free of cost.

dca927f0-b184-4fea-a9f3-5a12476bfa02.title: TN Free Electricity Scheme for Agriculture (24x7 Power)
dca927f0-b184-4fea-a9f3-5a12476bfa02.title_ta: விவசாயிகளுக்கான 24 மணி நேர இலவச மின்சார திட்டம்
dca927f0-b184-4fea-a9f3-5a12476bfa02.eligibility_description: Farmers owning agricultural land with a valid TANGEDCO agricultural electricity service connection in Tamil Nadu.
dca927f0-b184-4fea-a9f3-5a12476bfa02.benefits_summary: 100% free 24-hour electricity for running irrigation pumps.

45853771-489d-44c8-aa74-0be0c80f40fc.title: Anna Bhagya Scheme (Karnataka)
45853771-489d-44c8-aa74-0be0c80f40fc.eligibility_description: BPL cardholders and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration cardholders residing in Karnataka.
45853771-489d-44c8-aa74-0be0c80f40fc.benefits_summary: 5 kg free rice plus Rs 170 per person per month direct cash transfer in lieu of additional 5 kg rice.

32e1a39e-9a8e-4404-862a-05d7b28e035f.title: Shakthi Free Bus Travel Scheme for Women (Karnataka)
32e1a39e-9a8e-4404-862a-05d7b28e035f.eligibility_description: All women and transgender persons residing in Karnataka state.
32e1a39e-9a8e-4404-862a-05d7b28e035f.benefits_summary: 100% free bus travel across Karnataka state in non-AC city, ordinary, and express state transport buses.

7e9f2a28-3d01-40a2-9c04-80af0b052e79.title: Rythu Bharosa Agriculture Support (Telangana)
7e9f2a28-3d01-40a2-9c04-80af0b052e79.eligibility_description: Landholding farmers and tenant farmers growing crops in Telangana state.
7e9f2a28-3d01-40a2-9c04-80af0b052e79.benefits_summary: Financial investment assistance of Rs 15,000 per acre per year (Rs 7,500 per season) transferred directly via DBT.
